name: Standup
description: Sandboxed project panel for daily check-ins. Compose done / today / blockers, copy a task comment, and stamp standup.last and standup.notes through a callback token or inbound set_field.
author: SentientTD Studios

fields.label: Last standup
fields.description: Date of the most recent check-in. The panel stamps this via set_field when you run the generated callback.

fields.label: Standup notes
fields.description: Latest blockers or follow-ups from the sandboxed panel. Sidebar only.
